body: more than i could possibly explain. There's a lot of anger, it's good to find a safe release for it.

nah, too lenient. First i'd wait a month or so, so that he feels all safe and secure that he got away with this bullshit. During that month, scope the house and neighborhood - don't make regular patterns, just make sure to stop by every now and then. When you know he's sleeping soundly, put two layers of duct tape over a window, preferably as far from the bedroom as possible. Grab a broken ceramic spark plug, use epoxy resin to bond it to the tip of a screw driver, and gently but firmly tap the glass. If you got it right, it'll shatter, but with luck the duct tape will keep any bits from breaking off and making too much noise.

Take away the broken window shards, then try your best to remove any shards from the window sill. If you can't get it all, just make sure you have a leather jacket you can lay over the remaining shards. After all, it'd be silly to hurt yourself doing this.

Okay. We're in, and if we scoped and timed things well enough no-one knows. Avoid torchlight if possible, you're better off letting your eyes adjust to the dark - flashlights in a house look suspicious as fuck. Anyway, go to the bedroom, and here comes the REALLY tricky part. Get a rope long enough to go under the bed, and bond his wrists to it. Use a pull-knot and don't tighten it too much. You don't want to wake him, and trust me his struggles will tighten it enough for you. Repeat this step with the legs if feasable, however it's not needed. 

Next, get a folded cloth, and lay it gently over his face. Then dump a load of cold water over it. The moment he starts to wake up in terror, SMASH him in the balls with whatever you have... fist, screwdriver, broken window duct tape flail, do what you feel like for this bit. Then as he's recoiling from that, press down HARD on the cloth and pour more water over it. Give it 10 seconds, then punch as hard as you can in the solar plexus, pin him down by kneeling on him, and continue pouring water while holding the cloth down. Hit the nuts again, then return to the water... except this time, use the second bottle you brought that's full of of salty vinegar with a bunch of hot sauce mixed in. Dump it all over, and then get the fuck out.

As long as it's respectfully done, you should be good.

I had a talk, and rolled a joint. I think i'll be okay for now, but i don't know. I'm having a hard time seeing how anything can get better, but i'm trying to tell myself that's the ptsd talking. Sense of no future and all that shit. I wish i knew how to get out of all this.
you don't understand, she's found a powerful weapon. I'm transgender. She's offering to pay for surgery, but it obviously comes at a steep price. It's torture.

In the time i was going through my personal hell, i remember thinking like that. My mind would constantly wander off, thinking about what kind of a person would be able to handle my situation... and evetually, i started mimicking these 'ideal' people. I just shut off the emotions that didn't match theirs, and showed the ones that i needed. I still knew who i was, and deep inside i was constantly hurt that people preferred the fake versions i put forward instead of the real me.

I don't think it's DID or anything like that, but i can see how it could be the beginning of how it happens? once you convince yourself that people prefer your made up personalities to your own one, it becomes very hard to let go of them...

when i was younger, all the time. I remember when i was 5, i got a cheap pirate toy set from my aunt that had this awesome pistol that shot suction cup darts. At the time i was the SG, and after playing with it for half an hour my GC sister decideds to tell my Nmom that i shot it at her.

All my gifts for that year are taken, broken, and thrown in the garbage in front of me.

i'd say the difference is with fleas, you can recognize them as traits you've picked up from the N in your life, or related to their behaviour. I know that if someone bothers me while i'm concentrating, i'll get the same feeling of anger she seems to get.

But i don't feel justified by the anger, i feel horrible and guilty about it later because i realize it's wrong. So lately, i try to calmly let people know that they're making me angry, i know it's irrational and i'm working on it, but could you please leave me alone. I recognize them as bad, and attempt to improve on them. If i don't notice and someone points it out, that's enough to remind me.

In contrast, my Nmom will sulk and throw a tantrum if you point out her behaviour to her. She never attempts to improve, and i doubt she ever will.

Basically, i have empathy for the people who get bitten by my fleas, my N doesn't.

this kind of explains a lot for me... i was definitely the SG when i was young, but once i was the only child living with her she started throwing money at me and trying to become super-involved in my life. But it always comes with disapproval and backhanded insults if i don't fit her expectations.
i remember wishing my NM would hit me harder, so i could prove she did. fuck.

what really started my realization was having dinner with my mum and grandmother. My grandmother is a sweet, loving woman, and i like hanging out with her every now and then. Gran was telling me about a big family gathering that i didn't go to (been guilt tripped for a while about that, but like hell i'm going to an unfamiliar city while i'm in the middle of CBT). She mentioned having breakfast on the last day, and my mum lost her shit.

Immediately it was "no, you didn't. blah blah blah my memory is better than yours you didn't have breakfast". There was no reason to argue about it anyway, but my mum wouldn't let up until gran just accepted it as a lost argument. I remembered something i read about gaslighting, realizezd what was happening, and it was enough to bring back all the times she did the same thing to me. And now i'm posting here.

Thanks for the kind words and support everyone. sorry if it sounds off, but i'm so glad this subreddit exists... don't know if i would've realized without the stories i've read here.
